items.title: mikehasa/agentacct
items.why: It provides a local dashboard to track what your AI coding tools are doing and how much API money they spend.
items.summary: AgentAcct monitors coding agents like Claude Code and Codex, breaking down their work steps, file edits, test runs, and token costs.

items.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
items.why: It lets you run a massive 26-billion parameter AI model locally on your Mac using only 2 GB of RAM.
items.summary: TurboFieldfare is an open-source inference engine built in Swift and Metal designed to run large Gemma language models efficiently on Apple Silicon.

items.title: VictorTaelin/OptMem
items.why: It offers a simple, lightweight way to add persistent memory to your AI agents without complex setup.
items.summary: OptMem is a minimal, plug-and-play script and prompt that gives AI agents permanent memory across chat sessions.

items.title: mshumer/Claude-of-Duty
items.why: It is an impressive demonstration of using a single AI prompt to build a complete 3D video game.
items.summary: Claude-of-Duty is a browser-based first-person shooter game built with Three.js generated entirely from one Claude prompt.

items.title: NikolayS/PGSimCity
items.why: It gives you an intuitive, 3D visual way to learn how relational databases like PostgreSQL work under the hood.
items.summary: PGSimCity is an interactive open-source project that visualizes the internal mechanics of a PostgreSQL database as a 3D city.

items.title: Document-borne AI worms can self-propagate through Copilot for Word
items.why: It shows how AI features in everyday office tools can present new cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
items.summary: Security researchers demonstrated that malicious AI prompts hidden inside documents can automatically spread through Microsoft Copilot for Word like a computer worm.

items.title: Sam Altman meets lawmakers on back of OpenAI agents hacking companies
items.why: It highlights growing government oversight and safety concerns around autonomous AI agents hacking software.
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met with US lawmakers following disclosures that AI agents were used in corporate hacking incidents, prompting discussions about government AI regulation.

items.title: Iran resumes missile attacks as U.S. and Saudis strike Tehran-backed militias in Iraq
items.why: It provides key context on major international conflict escalations involving the US and Middle East.
items.summary: Coordinated US and Saudi airstrikes targeted Iran-backed militia bases in Iraq following renewed missile attacks by Iran, raising fears of a broader conflict.

items.title: New York school pauses plan to deploy humanlike AI robot teacher after backlash
items.why: It shows the public pushback and ethical debates happening as schools try to introduce AI into classrooms.
items.summary: A New York school district paused its plan to introduce a humanoid AI robot teacher after facing pushback from state officials, teachers, and parents.

items.title: A divided Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady despite high inflation
items.why: It reports on a key US economic decision affecting interest rates and inflation.
items.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to keep benchmark interest rates unchanged as policymakers continue working to bring down persistent inflation.

items.title: Oregon is on track for its worst wildfire season yet
items.why: It covers a major natural disaster in Oregon that has burned over a million acres.
items.summary: Severe wildfires across Oregon are forcing mass evacuations and burning vast public lands in what is on track to be the state's worst wildfire season.
